thread:
sam: flipped a small canary to marlin-int6 (ptq) on onboard traffic. quick sweep: structured-output pass ~97.8% but a recurring class of truncated jsons at the end of streaming responses.

jules: reproducer from logs (trimmed):
```
{"action":"create_ticket","params":{"title":"Order failed","user_id":12345}
...<stream cut>
```
parser: unexpected EOF while expecting '}'

maya: are failures exclusively streaming? any pattern vs batch size or sequence length?

sam: baseline looks fine for non-streaming in the sample. canary streaming batch_size=4, max_seq=1024.

kai: this smells like a kv-cache alignment/attention kernel edge on the int6 code path. we've seen token dropout when seq boundaries hit specific kernel tiling.

nora: could also be stream flush race during worker preempt. if final chunk is lost we get truncated json. do we have worker_preempt counts for the window?

jules: metric snapshot: preempt spikes align with parse_fail spikes. also observed double-eos markers "\\u0003\\u0003" in some streams; our streamer sometimes treats that as two EOFs.

maya: short-term options: (1) client-side json-healer to append close-brace heuristics for canary; (2) force explicit sentinel final chunk from streamer ("\n\n" or explicit DONE token) long-term.

sam: i prefer a probing approach. toggle a fraction of canary to non-streaming to narrow root cause. if non-streaming passes, it's streaming-only.

kai: agree. if we confirm streaming-only, plan a microquant rebuild and tiny ptq rerun with kernel alignment fix.

jules: i switched 10% of canary to sync-mode. monitoring parse_fail_rate and last_chunk_length now.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy marlin-int6 -> 2026-03-23T15:34:10Z (id: cd3f2a)

nora: also propose a one-off retry budget: if parse fails and response_len > 128 tokens, retry once in sync-mode and waive quota for canary.

maya: +1. also capture masked last-8 tokens of output for failed parses (no PII) to distinguish kernel trim vs streamer drop.

sam: short-term rollout plan: (a) probe sync-mode 10% (done), (b) enable client json-healer for canary only, (c) allow single retry on parse-fail for long responses, (d) collect end-of-stream snippets. i'll run eval harness comparing struct-output pass across float baseline / int8 / int6 after 2h.

jules: wiring metrics: parse_fail_rate, preempt_count, last_chunk_length, double_eos_count. dashboard ETA 30m.

kai: if metrics confirm kernel misalignment, next is microquant rebuild + ptq re-run and a narrow canary of that build.

nora: if anyone sees non-streaming failures ping me; i can pull worker cores and live traces.

maya: will post harness diffs when ready. thanks :eyes:

sam: good work. keeping canary tight. tagging infra to watch vm evictions. @infra? (not in thread)
